title: Sr. Software Engineer – Ads Orchestration
description:
Hos TV4 möts teknik, innovation, nyhetsjournalistik, sport och underhållning.
   

  

 Varje vecka använder omkring åtta miljoner människor TV4 Play och MTV Katsomo. Reklamaffären är en central del av det som finansierar både våra streamingtjänster och det innehåll vi producerar.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en Senior Software Engineer till Ads Orchestration – teamet som bygger de produktförmågor som gör det möjligt att sälja, leverera, mäta och utveckla framtidens annonsaffär.
   

  

****Varför den här rollen är viktig****
 Vi moderniserar just nu hela vår annonsplattform.
   

  

 Från hur kampanjer säljs och bokas till hur de planeras, levereras, optimeras, mäts och följs upp.
   

  

 Samtidigt konsoliderar vi systemen bakom TV4 Play och MTV Katsomo till en gemensam nordisk plattform.
   

  

 Det här handlar inte bara om teknik.
   

  

 Det handlar om att skapa förutsättningar för att snabbare utveckla nya annonsprodukter, möta förändrade marknadsbehov och ge verksamheten större frihet att utveckla affären.
   

  

 Vi ersätter externa beroenden med egenutvecklade tjänster och bygger en plattform som kan utvecklas i takt med verksamheten under många år framåt.
   

  

****Varför du vill kliva ombord****
 Du vill vara med i ett team som äger mer än kod.
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar du nära produkt, användare och verksamhet för att förstå vilka problem som är värda att lösa och hur vi vet att lösningarna skapar effekt.
   

  

 Du trivs när teamet tar ansvar för hela resan – från idé och prioritering till implementation, lansering, uppföljning och vidareutveckling.
   

  

 Du gillar komplexa flöden, integrationer och affärskritiska processer, men framför allt motiveras du av att göra dem begripliga, användbara och värdeskapande.
   

  

 Du lockas av möjligheten att bygga nytt i en miljö där teknik, produkt och affär arbetar tätt tillsammans för att skapa verkligt värde.
   

  

 Du ser AI som ett naturligt verktyg i modern produktutveckling och är nyfiken på hur nya arbetssätt kan hjälpa team att lära snabbare, bygga smartare och skapa mer värde.
   

  

****Om teamet****
 Ads Orchestration skapar förutsättningar för en effektiv och framtidssäker annonsaffär.
   

  

 Teamet bygger produktförmågor som kopplar ihop behov från användare, kunder och partners med digitala flöden som skapar tydligt affärsvärde.
   

  

 Vi arbetar där teknik, produkt och annonsaffär möts – med målet att minska friktion, öka transparens och hjälpa TV4 utveckla annonsprodukter snabbare och mer träffsäkert.
   

  

 Som Senior Software Engineer blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team med tydligt produktfokus och nära samarbete med stakeholders, användare och affärspartners.
   

  

****Vad du kommer att göra****
* Bygga och vidareutveckla skalbara tjänster i en cloud-native och modulär arkitektur
* Utveckla lösningar över hela stacken med tyngd inom backend
* Designa API:er och integrationer som kopplar samman produkter, plattformar och verksamhetsprocesser
* Bidra till arkitekturbeslut och tekniska vägval
* Arbeta aktivt med AI-verktyg i utvecklingsprocessen
* Ta ansvar för observability, monitorering och kontinuerliga förbättringar
* Samarbeta nära produkt, användare och stakeholders för att omsätta behov till fungerande lösningar
* Bidra till att forma nästa generation av TV4:s annonsplattform


****Om dig****
 Du är en erfaren fullstackutvecklare med tydlig tyngd inom backend.
   

  

 Du trivs i gränslandet mellan produkt, teknik och affär och motiveras av att bygga lösningar som skapar verkligt värde för användare och verksamhet.
   

  

 Du har ett ingenjörsmässigt tänk, uppskattar hög autonomi och gillar att arbeta i team som tar ansvar från idé till lansering och vidareutveckling.
   

  

 Vi tror också att du:
   

  

* Har minst 5 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling i moderna system, med tyngd inom backend
* Har erfarenhet av Node, TypeScript, React och molnbaserade lösningar
* Har arbetat med API:er, integrationer och användarnära delar av en produkt
* Trivs i tvärfunktionella team och arbetar gärna nära produkt, design, användare och stakeholders
* Är en god kommunikatör och kan förklara komplexa koncept på ett enkelt sätt
* Har anammat AI som verktyg för att höja kvalitet, lärande och produktivitet


 Det är ett extra plus om du har erfarenhet av domäner med komplexa flöden, integrationer och höga krav på spårbarhet, exempelvis annonsering, betalningar, orderflöden eller logistik.
   

  

****Nuvarande tech stack****
**Backend:** 
 Node, TypeScript
   

  

**Frontend:** 
 React, React Native
   

  

**Moln:** 
 AWS
   

  

**Databaser:** 
 PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
   

  

**DevOps & Observability:** 
 GitHub Actions, Terraform, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
   

  

**AI & Developer Tooling:** 
 Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, CLI/MCP-integrationer
   

  

**Produktivitet:** 
 Linear, Notion, Slack
   

  

****Vad TV4 erbjuder dig****
* Kort väg från idé till beslut i en senior teknikorganisation med hög autonomi för både team och individ
* En kultur som värdesätter hållbara tekniska lösningar framför snabba genvägar
* Möjlighet att vara med och bygga nästa generations annonsplattform för TV4 och MTV
* Kollegor med hög teknisk kompetens och stort ägandeskap
* Du loggar ut på riktigt efter jobbet. Vi har dedikerad on-call där det är relevant och förväntar oss inte att du ska vara tillgänglig utanför arbetstid
* Modernt kontor med gym, restaurang, garage och takterrass

title: Senior Developer
description:
Senior Backend Developer – Pagero TMS
   

  

 Are you curious about developing the transport logistics solutions of the future? Do you want to work with a modern tech stack, take technical ownership, and help build a global product that truly makes a difference?
   

  

 We are now looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join an experienced and close-knit team that develops and maintains Pagero TMS – a leading cloud-based solution for transport logistics.
   

  

**About Pagero TMS And Pagero**
 Pagero TMS helps transport buyers create transparency and control over their external logistics – financially, operationally, and environmentally – regardless of mode of transport. The solution is an integrated subsystem within the Pagero ecosystem.
   

  

 Pagero is now part of Thomson Reuters. Together, we are developing OneSource, the world’s largest open business network. OneSource enables companies to digitize and automate entire workflows from procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, and shipping – including all technical and regulatory requirements – through a single connection. The platform offers global reach with local compliance and real-time visibility.
   

  

 The Team and Way of Working
   

  

 The product development team works with a microservices-based architecture and a strong DevOps culture, where teams own the entire lifecycle – from design and development to operations and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will be part of a team focused on further developing our scalable cloud service and collaborating closely with sister teams, including teams in Sri Lanka.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Backend Developer, you will:
   

  

* Develop and further enhance backend solutions in a modern microservices architecture
* Work with functional programming and JVM-based development (Scala, ZIO)
* Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, and production of robust services
* Work with Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, asynchronous queue systems (RabbitMQ/AMQP), and REST APIs
* When needed, contribute to the maintenance and further development of user interfaces in React
* Collaborate with other teams within Pagero and Thomson Reuters, both nationally and internationally
* The position is hybrid, with office presence three days per week in Stockholm.


**Requirements**
**About You**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or an engineering discipline with an IT focus
* At least 5 years of professional experience in software development
* Experience with functional programming languages and the JVM platform, preferably Scala
* Experience with Kubernetes
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases
* Experience with asynchronous queue systems (e.g., RabbitMQ/AMQP) and REST/Swagger
* Strong proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written


**Meriting Qualifications**
* - Experience with frontend development in React
* - Experience within the transport logistics domain and understanding of related information flows
* - Experience improving development processes using AI-based tools
* - Experience building AI-based products
* Personal Qualities
* - You are passionate about solving complex problems in close collaboration with others
* - You thrive in an open development culture with code reviews and technical discussions
* - You have experience across multiple technical ecosystems and are eager to learn new things


 The position requires successful completion of an enhanced background check.
   

  

**Senior backendutvecklare – Pagero TMS**
 Är du nyfiken på att utveckla framtidens transportlogistiklösningar? Vill du arbeta i en modern tech-stack, ta stort tekniskt ansvar och vara med och bygga en global produkt som gör verklig skillnad?
   

  

 Nu söker vi en senior backendutvecklare som vill bli en del av ett erfaret och sammansvetsat team som utvecklar och förvaltar Pagero TMS – en ledande molnbaserad lösning för transportlogistik.
   

  

 Om Pagero TMS och Pagero
   

  

 Pagero TMS hjälper transportköpare att skapa transparens och kontroll över sin externa logistik – finansiellt, operationellt och miljömässigt – oavsett transportsätt. Lösningen är ett integrerat delsystem i Pageros ekosystem.
   

  

 Pagero är numera en del av Thomson Reuters. Tillsammans utvecklar vi OneSource, världens största öppna affärsnätverk. OneSource gör det möjligt för företag att digitalisera och automatisera hela flödena från inköp till betalning, order till kassa och frakt – inklusive alla tekniska och regulatoriska krav – genom en enda anslutning. Plattformen erbjuder global räckvidd med lokal efterlevnad och realtidssynlighet.
   

  

 Teamet och arbetssättet
   

  

 Produktutvecklingsteamet arbetar i en mikrotjänstbaserad arkitektur med stark DevOps-kultur, där teamen äger hela livscykeln – från design och utveckling till drift och kontinuerliga förbättringar.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett team som fokuserar på att vidareutveckla vår skalbara molntjänst och samarbetar tätt med systerteam, bland annat i Sri Lanka.
   

  

**Om rollen**
**Som Senior Backendutvecklare Kommer Du Att**
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla backendlösningar i en modern mikrotjänstarkitektur
* Arbeta med funktionell programmering och JVM-baserad utveckling (Scala, ZIO)
* Bidra till design, implementation, testning och produktion av robusta tjänster
* Arbeta med Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, asynkrona kösystem (RabbitMQ/AMQP) och REST-API:er
* Vid behov bidra till underhåll och vidareutveckling av användargränssnitt i React
* Samarbeta med andra team inom Pagero och Thomson Reuters, både nationellt och internationellt


 Tjänsten är hybrid med kontorsnärvaro tre dagar i veckan i Stockholm.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Krav
   

  

* Kandidatexamen eller högre inom datavetenskap eller ingenjörsutbildning med inriktning mot IT
* Minst 5 års professionell erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
* Erfarenhet av funktionella språk och JVM-plattformen, gärna Scala
* Erfarenhet av Kubernetes
* Erfarenhet av relations- och/eller NoSQL-databaser
* Erfarenhet av asynkrona kösystem (t.ex. RabbitMQ/AMQP) och REST/Swagger
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

 Post- and pre-sales support including training our colleagues, customers and distributors.

title: Teknisk Testare
description:
*Vi på Bankgirot har valt att ta ansvar för något större än oss själva: att forma framtidens betalsystem i Sverige. Sedan 1959 har våra lösningar haft en betydande påverkan på miljoner människors liv varje dag. Nu genomgår vi en omfattande transformation och söker en Teknisk Testare som vill spela en central roll i att driva utvecklingen av våra system och processer framåt.*
**Om rollen**
 Som Teknisk Testare på Bankgirot har du en bärande funktion i att kvalitetssäkra och driva testarbete i en agil utvecklingsmiljö. Du arbetar i tvärfunktionella team där test är en integrerad del av utvecklingsprocessen från start, och bidrar med ett tekniskt testperspektiv genom hela flödet.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en Teknisk Testare som har en viktig roll i att säkerställa kvalitet i backend inom verksamhetskritiska systemmiljöer. Rollens tyngdpunkt ligger inom testautomation.
   

  

 I rollen arbetar du nära utvecklare, kravställare och andra intressenter för att identifiera risker, definiera relevanta testinsatser och bidra till en stabil och kvalitetssäkrad leverans.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som har minst tre års erfarenhet av teknisk testning inom Java och som trivs i miljöer där systemen är komplexa och kvalitet är affärskritiskt. Du är van att arbeta strukturerat, har ett tekniskt intresse och förstår värdet av test som en naturlig del av utvecklingen.
   

  

 Du är trygg i testautomation i backend, och kan läsa och skriva enklare kod i Java. Du har god förståelse för hur testramverk används i praktiken och är van att arbeta med Git som en naturlig del av utvecklings- och testprocessen.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

  

* Erfarenhet inom testautomatisering eller QA inom backend
* Kodförståelse i Java och förmåga att själv skriva kod på junior nivå
* Erfarenhet av testning mot databas, exempelvis SQL
* Erfarenhet av testning av APIer, mikrotjänster och systemintegrationer


 Rollen kan utvecklas över tid och på sikt även omfatta icke-funktionell testning, vilket gör att erfarenhet av eller intresse för detta område är meriterande. Vi ser det som meriterande med erfarenhet inom reglerad verksamhet.
   

  

**Så arbetar vi tillsammans**
 Hos oss arbetar vi gärna tillsammans på kontoret – det stärker samarbete, lärande och vår gemensamma kultur. Här finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas i yrkesrollen och ta nästa steg över tid. Vi erbjuder också förmåner som gör skillnad i vardagen, som eget gym, generöst friskvårdsbidrag, cykelförmån samt trygga pensions- och försäkringslösningar.
   

  

**Säkerhetsprövning**
 För den här rollen genomförs säkerhetsprövning innan anställning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) – en naturlig del av vårt ansvar att tillsammans värna tryggheten i Sveriges betalsystem.
   

  

**Anställningsform:** 
 Tillsvidare
   

  

**Övrigt:** 
 Du behöver ha goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
   

  

**Tillträde:** 
 Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

 Vill du vara med och skapa framdrift? Då är du en av oss!
   

  

 Kontakta Ellika Ulltin på ellika.ulltin@ants.se för mer information. Urval sker löpande – välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  

**Om Bankgirot**
 Sedan starten 1959 har vi stått för den tekniska strukturen som binder samman Sveriges banker i vårt nationella betalsystem. Vår historia är rik på innovation, engagemang och stolthet över vårt samhällsviktiga uppdrag. Genom vår expertkunskap och vår starka kultur, Bankgiroandan, arbetar vi varje dag för att säkerställa att varje transaktion sker sömlöst och effektivt.
   

  

 Tillsammans med våra kunder och samarbetspartners skapar vi resultat och långsiktigt värde som gynnar marknaden, samhället och Bankgirot. Som en förenande kraft gör vi det möjligt att forma en moderniserad och framtidssäkrad svensk betalinfrastruktur. Vi förenar, förvaltar och förnyar betalsverige!
   

  

 Läs mer på www.bankgirot.se
   

  

 Bankgirot är ett svenskt clearinghus och teknikbolag med över 60 års erfarenhet av att leverera finansiell infrastruktur till banker. I samverkan med betalsektorn ser vi till att privatpersoner och företag enkelt kan göra överföringar och betalningar. Bankgirot säkerställer att det nuvarande betalsystemet fungerar felfritt, samtidigt som vi utvecklar framtidssäkrade lösningar. Vi förenar, förvaltar och förnyar betalsverige.

**Job Description**
**Senior Platform Engineer** 
**– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)**
**Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.**
**About The Company**
 Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.
   

  

**The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions**
**Public 360° – Case and archive management**
**Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications**
**eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage**
**The challenge**
 We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.
   

  

**The role**
 As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
* Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
* Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
* Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
* Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
* Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.


**Required Qualifications**
* Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
* Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
* Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
+ Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
+ Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
+ Networking, security, and scalability.
+ Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

* Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
* Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
* Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
* Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
* Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.


**Tech we use**
 We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.
   

  

**Why join us**
* Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
* Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
* Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
* Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
* Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
* A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.


**Practicalities**
**Location and work setup:** 
 Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).
   

  

**Language requirements:** 
 Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

 We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

 **Ida Sirevaag**

title: ML Ops Engineer
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 Neko's mission is to help people stay healthy through preventive care and early detection. The MLOps Engineering Lead owns the ML infrastructure that translates sensor data into clinical inference results for Neko members, covering skin and cardio models today and expanding into new health domains. This role is the difference between ML that works in notebooks and ML that works in production at scale, reliably and within SLA, directly enabling the quality of insights Neko delivers to every member.
   

  

 What You'll Deliver in the First 6-12 Months
   

  

* Reusable MLOps component library adopted by Data Science and ML Engineering teams, reducing time-to-production for new models. (Chase 10X, not 10%)
* Business-critical inference workflows (skin, cardio) fully owned, monitored, and operating within defined SLAs. (Impact, not activity)
* Experiment tracking, model lifecycle, and evaluation standards documented and embedded across the Data Science Platform team, with adoption by at least two engineers. (Tech-enabled, human-centred)
* Databricks/Azure ML infrastructure right-sized, cost-tracked, and optimised for the current model estate. (Impact, not activity)
* MLOps best practices actively taught and adopted by at least two engineers who lacked prior MLOps grounding. (Member-first, always)


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Production-grade Python fluency: demonstrated experience building and owning end-to-end ML systems in production, not just contributing to them.
* ML orchestration ownership: hands-on experience with Dagster or equivalent, including design decisions, not just configuration.
* Kubernetes and containerised workload management in a production context.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or equivalent, applied to ML infrastructure.
* Distributed systems and data pipeline design across multiple data sources or domains.
* Experiment tracking and model lifecycle management: MLFlow or equivalent, embedded into team workflows.
* Strong communication: able to teach MLOps concepts to Data Scientists and Engineers without an MLOps background, and make architectural recommendations across engineering and science teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with PyTorch model serving and inference optimisation at production scale.
* Familiarity with Azure ML, AKS, and Blob Storage in an integrated ML platform context.
* Prior work in regulated environments: medical devices, ISO 13485, or equivalent.
* Exposure to computer vision or sensor data pipelines (skin, cardio, LiDAR, DICOM).
* Experience onboarding non-MLOps engineers onto platform tooling.


**About The Engineering Team**
 We have nearly 160 full-time engineers working across our hubs in Stockholm, London, and Berlin, spanning disciplines including Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Electrical Design, Algorithm Development, Machine Learning, Optronics Research, and Frontend Development. We don't expect you to join us with specific tech knowledge, but we do expect you to work with our tools: React, TypeScript, C++, and Python. Our APIs are written in C# with ASP.NET Core, using Azure Cosmos DB and Azure Active Directory for authentication.
   

  

 Our headquarters and hardware development team are based in Stockholm. We work hybrid, with engineers typically in the office 1-2 days a week. Hardware and firmware engineers need occasional on-site access to devices, so tend toward the higher end of that; software engineers have more flexibility. We come together as a full team a couple of times a year.
   

  

 Organization and Way of Working
   

  

 Engineering teams are structured into small, cross-functional groups aligned to specific goals. Some teams are long-lived while others are formed for targeted initiatives. Teams aim to operate autonomously while collaborating across the organization when necessary.
   

  

 Goals are tracked quarterly and annually, with bi-weekly organization-wide progress reviews. Most teams operate on a bi-weekly planning cadence, though each group has flexibility in how they work.
   

  

 All teams present progress, learnings, and experiments during bi-weekly engineering demos, covering topics ranging from hardware and calibration challenges to infrastructure improvements, backend capabilities, and data innovations that enhance clinical productivity.
   

  

 Neko Health supports a flexible workplace that prioritizes work-life balance. We are deeply committed to our mission while believing meaningful impact should not require sacrificing personal wellbeing.
   

  

 Compensation Range: €100K - €150K

title: Säkerhetstekniker till anstalten Österåker
description:
**Om Kriminalvården**




 Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter.
   

  





 Verksamhetsområde Stockholm Öst omfattar de två slutna anstalterna Österåker och Täby. Hos oss arbetar framför allt kriminalvårdare, men också vårdpersonal, lärare, administratörer, produktionsledare och andra viktiga yrkesgrupper. Klienterna på anstalterna sysselsätts med bland annat utbildning, behandlingsprogram, verkstadsarbete samt monterings- och förpackningsuppdrag – allt för att skapa struktur, meningsfullhet och förutsättningar för en bättre framtid.
   

  





  

 Anstalten Österåker är inne i en spännande expansionsfas med nya anstaltsplatser och sysselsättningslokaler som tas i drift mellan 2025 och 2027. Här finns goda möjligheter att växa med verksamheten – både i antal medarbetare och i nya, spännande roller. Anstalten ligger utanför Åkersberga – perfekt för dig som uppskattar att slippa rusningstrafiken. Bil är det smidigaste sättet att ta sig hit. Anstalten Täby är en liten anstalt med familjär miljö och goda pendlingsmöjligheter. Båda anstalterna erbjuder personalparkering.
   

  





  

 Vi värnar om en hälsofrämjande arbetsmiljö - på anstalten Österåker finns därför personalgym. Det finns dessutom en uppskattad personalrestaurang där du kan äta och umgås med dina kollegor.
   

  





**Arbetsbeskrivning**




 Som säkerhetstekniker inom verksamhetsområde Stockholm Öst arbetar du med högteknologiska, nätverksanslutna säkerhetssystem och ansvarar tillsammans med din kollega för lokal utveckling, drift, underhåll, utbyten, service, egenkontroller och felsökning. Det omfattar bland annat överordnade larmsystem, samtalsanläggningar, överfallslarmsystem, CCTV/kamerasystem, bildlagringsservrar, larm- och passersystem samt interna och externa telefonisystem. Du arbetar även med nätverk, fysiska och virtuella servrar, lagring och nätverksövervakning.
   

  





 I rollen ingår även behörighetsadministration, dokumentation, registervård, inventering och kontroll av säkerhetsrelaterad utrustning, exempelvis nycklar, samt hårdvarusupport. Tillsammans med chef ansvarar du för att säkerhetssystemens infrastruktur möter Kriminalvårdens behov. Du planerar kravspecifikationer och beställningar, säkerställer att större arbeten genomförs av leverantörer och fungerar som teknisk support i säkerhetstekniska frågor. Du informerar, utbildar och handleder personal i handhavandet av säkerhetsanordningar samt är lås- och nyckelansvarig. Arbetsuppgifterna utförs inom hela verksamhetsområdet, även i klientmiljö.
   

  





 Du delar arbetsuppgifter med en annan säkerhetstekniker och vid behov samarbetar du även med tekniker vid andra anstalter och häkten. Tjänstgöring sker på anstalterna Täby och Österåker. Vid behov bistår du även övriga enheter inom regionen i säkerhetstekniska frågor. Tjänsteresor ingår i uppdraget.
   

  





**Kvalifikationer**




 Som säkerhetstekniker ser vi att du har god samarbetsförmåga och en hög servicekänsla. Du har förmåga att självständigt planera, organisera och anpassa ditt arbete samt att driva och slutföra arbetsuppgifter inom utsatt tid. Eftersom din funktion är viktig för verksamhetens drift behöver du vara flexibel, lösningsorienterad och lyhörd för verksamhetens behov. Då arbetet är komplext krävs även god analytisk och problemlösande förmåga samt ett praktiskt handlag.
   

  





 Du har ett genuint intresse för säkerhetsteknik och säkerhetsarbete. För att trivas och lyckas i ditt uppdrag är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen och tron på att människan är utvecklingsbar. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  





**Vi söker dig som har:** 



* Gymnasieskolekompetens och gärna med inriktning på teknik/el/IT eller annan utbildning inom säkerhetsteknik som Kriminalvården bedömer likvärdig
* Erfarenhet som tekniker med övergripande larmsystem såsom överordnade system, CCTV-system, passagesystem eller annan erfarenhet som Kriminalvården bedömer likvärdig
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
* B-körkort



**Det är även meriterande med:** 



* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom teknik/el/säkerhet
* Goda kunskaper i nätverksteknik och Windows-baserade system
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom Kriminalvårdens tekniska system
* Kunskaper inom felsökning, kopplingar och dokumentation i teletekniska anläggningar
* Erfarenhet av nyckel- och låshantering



**Övrigt**




 Kriminalvården har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen.
   

  





 För att bli aktuell för anställning inom Kriminalvården krävs att du motsvarar högt ställda krav gällande lämplighet, omdöme, säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetande och att du följer gällande lagar. Det innebär att du står upp för demokratiska värderingar och den statliga värdegrund som gäller för Kriminalvårdens verksamhet.
   

  





 Vissa befattningar är placerade i säkerhetsklass och då kommer en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. För vissa säkerhetsklassade tjänster krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Kriminalvården välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Läs mer om säkerhetsprövning här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/sakerhetsprovning-vid-rekrytering/
   

  





 Befattningen kan innebära krigsplacering vid Kriminalvården. Läs mer om krigsplacering här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/krigsplacering/
   

  





 Individuell lönesättning tillämpas.
   

  





 Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.
   

  





 Kriminalvården strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ökad mångfald. 
   

  





 För att skicka in din ansökan, klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. Frågor om hur du ansöker och lägger in ditt CV ställer du direkt till Varbi. Frågor om specifika jobb besvaras av den kontaktperson som anges i annonsen. 
   

  





 Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av rekryteringsannonser. Kriminalvården har upphandlade avtal.

title: Content Strategist
description:
Voyado is looking for a Content Strategist with native-level English proficiency to join our Marketing team in Stockholm.
   

  

 This role is for someone who enjoys turning complex products into clear, engaging stories and understands how content drives real business impact. You’ll play a key role in how we communicate Voyado’s value across product launches, sales enablement, customer engagement, and growth initiatives.
   

  

 You’ll join a collaborative team where Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer teams work closely together, and where your work will directly impact how we position and scale in our markets.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Content Strategist, you'll develop and produce content that drives customer engagement, adoption, and growth.
   

  

 A key part of the role is translating positioning, buyer perspectives, and customer value into scalable, high-impact content that delivers clarity, relevance, and commercial impact across channels. You'll work closely with Marketing, GTM, and Sales to create consistency across launches, campaigns, and enablement initiatives.
   

  

**In this role, you will:**
* Develop content such as launch materials, guides, case studies, webinars, original research, and thought leadership, translating positioning into structured plans that support launches, campaigns, and lifecycle communication
* Choose the right channel and format for each idea based on where it sits in the customer journey, and push for real variety: written, video, thought leadership, original research, interactive formats, whatever fits the story, then repurpose it into scalable formats across channels
* Own storytelling backed by original research: spot the questions worth building data around, and turn what you learn into content that clearly communicates outcomes, ROI, and value
* Act as an editorial voice in our SEO/AEO work
* Ensure alignment across website, campaigns, PR, events, and enablement materials
* Monitor performance and continuously refine content based on data and feedback
* Use AI tools to improve research, production, and scalability
* Help build structures and frameworks that improve how the team works with content


 Who you are
   

  

 You enjoy combining creativity with structure. You're curious, commercially minded, and comfortable working cross-functionally.
   

  

 You have experience working with SaaS products and know how to translate complexity into communication that is clear, credible, and relevant for different audiences.
   

  

**We believe you have:**
* Experience in B2B content marketing within SaaS or technology
* Experience supporting GTM and marketing initiatives
* Strong ability to translate positioning into compelling content
* Experience producing both thought leadership and commercial assets, including original research
* Understanding of sales-led mid-market or enterprise environments
* A data-driven approach to improving content performance
* Experience working cross-functionally and contributing to shared goals
* Strong writing and editorial skills, with native-level fluency in English
* Comfortable using AI daily to extend research, production, and iteration


**Nice to have**
 Something of your own that shows you understand audience-building firsthand. A newsletter, a podcast, an active personal channel, anything you've grown yourself rather than studied from the outside.
   

  

 What's in it for you?
   

  

 You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.
   

  

 At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.
   

  

 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* 30 days of vacation
* Wellness allowance
* Personal development opportunities
* Summits and team activities
* Four days from the office and one day from home


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.
   

  

 More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
   

  

 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact?
   

  

 Fantastic! 🎉
   

  

 Applying is easy — submit your LinkedIn profile or upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
   

  

 Making it personal with AI
   

  

 We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.
   

  

 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

title: AI Business Development Manager - EMEA/LATAM
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
 At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
   

  

 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
   

  

 Job Summary:
   

  

 NetApp is uniquely positioned to help organizations unlock the value of AI through the data they already manage. With a significant share of the world's unstructured data residing on NetApp, we help enterprises and public sector organizations build and scale AI initiatives across training, inferencing, data pipelines, RAG architectures, sovereign AI platforms, and modern AI infrastructure.
   

  

 The AI Business Development Manager will be responsible for creating demand, generating qualified pipeline, and accelerating AI-related business growth across EMEA/LATAM. This is a highly strategic business development role focused on identifying opportunities, engaging customers and partners, and converting AI interest into measurable pipeline and bookings. Success is measured by pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and revenue impact.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Drive AI Pipeline & Growth
   

  

* Lead AI pipeline generation across EMEA/LATAM, creating qualified opportunities and driving business growth.
* Identify, prioritize, and engage target accounts using market insights, AI adoption trends, and installed-base opportunities.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and strategic partners to execute demand-generation activities that create pipeline and accelerate bookings.
* Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders and help shape AI strategies and opportunities.
* Expand AI adoption within existing customers and support acquisition of net-new AI-focused organizations.


 Develop AI Go-to-Market Strategy
   

  

* Develop and refine AI value propositions covering AI infrastructure, data pipelines, sovereign AI, inferencing, and emerging AI workloads.
* Build repeatable go-to-market programs including account targeting, messaging, competitive positioning, and business value frameworks.
* Measure and optimize program performance based on pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and business impact.


 Enable Sales & Partners
   

  

* Equip Client Executives, Systems Engineers, and partners with the tools and knowledge needed to identify and advance AI opportunities.
* Deliver enablement, account planning support, and strategic guidance to increase AI opportunity creation.
* Support key opportunities through executive engagement, business case development, and competitive strategy.


 Build the AI Ecosystem
   

  

* Develop relationships with hyperscalers, GPU vendors, systems integrators, AI software providers, and cloud partners.
* Drive joint go-to-market initiatives and partner-led pipeline generation.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Generate consistent, high-quality AI pipeline across EMEA/LATAM.
* Increase AI-related bookings and improve conversion rates.
* Grow AI adoption within existing customers and secure new AI-focused accounts.
* Increase partner-sourced opportunities and ecosystem engagement.
* Drive adoption of AI sales plays across the wider Sales and technical organizations.


 Job Requirements:
   

  

**Required**
* 8+ years of experience in Business Development, Strategic Sales, Go-to-Market, AI, Cloud, or Enterprise Technology roles.
* Proven track record of generating pipeline and influencing business growth within emerging or high-growth technology markets.
* Experience creating target account strategies and executing measurable outbound demand-generation programs.
* Working knowledge of AI infrastructure, including GPU environments, model training and inferencing, data pipelines, RAG architectures, vector databases, and AI platforms.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes and executive-level value propositions.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills across matrixed organizations.
* Fluent English and willingness to travel across EMEA/LATAM as required.


**Preferred**
* Experience working with hyperscalers, AI ecosystem partners, systems integrators, or channel-led sales models.
* Understanding of AI regulation, data sovereignty, and compliance considerations across Europe and international markets.
* Experience building new GTM motions, market development programs, and strategic growth initiatives from the ground up.
* Existing relationships within the AI ecosystem, including AI startups, sovereign AI initiatives, cloud providers, GPU vendors, or AI-focused partners.
* Additional European language skills are advantageous.


 Why Join NetApp?
   

  

 This is an opportunity to help shape NetApp's AI growth strategy across EMEA and LATAM. You will work at the intersection of AI, data, cloud, and infrastructure, enabling organizations to accelerate AI adoption while helping build a scalable, repeatable growth engine for one of the industry's most important technology markets.
   

  

 At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
 NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
   

  

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
   

  

 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
   

  

**Our culture**
 We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
   

  

 If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
   

  

**Submitting an Application**
 To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.
   

  

**AI Disclosure**
 For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

title: Solution Consultant (Presales Engineer)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Your Career
   

  

 The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks.
   

  

* As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey.
* You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks.
* You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.


 Your Impact
   

  

**Role**
 Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
   

  

* Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions
* Understands Key customer business requirements and has the ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio solutions creating business value for customers
* Ability to drive customer adoption of Palo Alto Networks Platform.
* Building customer relationships by helping customers achieve increased productivity, operational efficiency, security efficacy, and greater flexibility to innovate
* Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
* Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions
* Demonstrating strong communication skills, influencing through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, and conducts technical engagements and workshops that are clear and impactful, simplifying complex ideas for various audiences
* Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities
* Demonstrates Cross functional leadership driving collaboration and orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy
* Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner
* Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating PANW's leadership in the cybersecurity space
* Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
* Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap


**Qualifications**
****Your Experience****
* 6+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering
* Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE
* Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred
* Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal
* Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements
* Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
* Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
* Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred
* This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
* Fluent in English and Swedish


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Teknisk säljare
description:
Teknisk säljare till Tsurumi Pump
   

  

 Vill du kombinera affärer, teknik och relationsbyggande i en roll med stort eget ansvar?
   

  

 På Tsurumi Pump arbetar vi med att sälja och marknadsföra högkvalitativa klimatprodukter till den svenska proffsmarknaden. Vi skiljer oss från mängden genom vår tekniska kompetens, personliga service och förmåga att överträffa kundernas förväntningar genom snabba och säkra leveranser. Vårt mål är att skapa långsiktigt lönsamma relationer med våra kunder.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en teknisk säljare med ansvar för Region Stockholm - Mälardalen.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som säljare hos oss blir du en viktig del av vår fortsatta tillväxt. Du ansvarar för att utveckla affären tillsammans med både nya och befintliga kunder som både är återförsäljare och slutkunder i regionen.
   

  

 Rollen innebär att du driver hela säljprocessen, från att identifiera och skapa nya affärsmöjligheter till att leda projekten hela vägen till avslut. Du säljer inte enbart produkter, du hjälper våra kunder att hitta rätt lösningar utifrån deras behov och projekt.
   

  

 Distriktet omfattar Mälardalen och lämplig bostadsort kan vara Stockholm. För oss är dock personen viktigare än postadressen.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
* Bearbeta och utveckla relationer med både nya och befintliga kunder
* Driva projektbaserad försäljning från första kontakt till avslut
* Identifiera och följa upp nya affärsmöjligheter
* Hantera inkommande förfrågningar och omvandla dem till affärer
* Vara en rådgivande partner genom hela kundens beslutsprocess


**Vem är du?**
 För att lyckas i rollen som säljare hos oss tror vi att du har en teknisk förståelse och ett starkt intresse för försäljning. Kanske arbetar du idag i en liknande roll med stort eget ansvar och vet att närvaro ute hos kund ger resultat.
   

  

 Vi värdesätter din potential, ditt driv och din vilja att utvecklas minst lika mycket.
   

  

 Vi tror att du:
   

  

* Har erfarenhet från en liknande teknisk säljroll är mycket meriterande
* Har teknisk förståelse och kunskap om byggprocesser
* Trivs med kundkontakt och relationsbyggande
* Är nyfiken, engagerad, affärsmässig, självgående och trygg i dig själv
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska


**Därför ska du välja Tsurumi Pump**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag med korta beslutsvägar, hög teknisk kompetens och stark framtidstro. Du blir en del av ett litet engagerat team där samarbete, kundfokus och affärsmässighet står i centrum. Vi erbjuder en roll med stor frihet under ansvar där du får möjlighet att påverka både din egen utveckling och företagets framtida framgång.
   

  

**Kontakt och ansökan**
 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Säljpoolens rekryteringskonsult Marie Gummerus. Du når Marie på 08-51481642.
   

  

 Skicka in din ansökan via ansökningsknappen. Vi arbetar med löpande urval under denna rekrytering, vi vill därför gärna ha in din ansökan snarast möjligt.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
**Om Tsurumi**
*Tsurumi-Intec Pump AB startade sin verksamhet i Sverige 1999 och har sedan dess levererat pumpar till företag inom uthyrning, entreprenad, industri, gruva samt kommuner. Vårt lager i Stora Höga med upp till 400 pumpar samt vårt Europa lager, beläget i Antwerpen, med sina ca 25 000 pumpar, borgar för snabba och tillförlitliga leveranser. Självklart har vi även slit- och eller reservdelar i lager till de flesta av våra pumpar. Läs mer om oss här:* 
 www.tsurumi.se/om-tsurumi

title: Projektledare / Produktägare för AI-accelererade team
description:
**Du är en erfaren konsult och ledare av digitala team. Nu vill du vara med på resan till att AI är en självklar del av både lösningen, arbetsflödet och teamet.**
 På B3 Business Transformation driver du projekt- eller produktteam hos välkända kunder – och är samtidigt med och formar nästa generation teamarbete där människor och AI-agenter jobbar sida vid sida. Vi är ca 45 seniora ledarkonsulter i en utvecklande och prestigelös kultur på en prisbelönt arbetsplats.
   

  

 Rollen
   

  

 Du leder team i utvecklingen av digitala produkter och tjänster i komplexa miljöer där digitalisering, data och AI är centrala delar. Teamen kan vara B3s, kundens, underleverantörers eller en kombination och fokus ligger på att skapa mätbar verksamhetsnytta – inte bara leverera funktion – genom att kombinera agil utveckling, användarcentrering och AI-drivna arbetssätt.
   

  

**Om dig**
**För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du**
* Har minst 5 års erfarenhet som projektledare, produktägare eller liknande roll inom digital utveckling
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult
* Är van att arbeta agilt, användarcentrerat med god förståelse för det digitala kundmötet och kan leda team i komplexa miljöer
* Använder AI-verktyg enligt nedan
* Trygg kommunikatör som rör dig obehindrat mellan ledning, verksamhet och utveckling
* Flytande svenska och engelska


**Meriterande**
* Relevant akademisk utbildning
* Certifieringar inom AI, SAFe, Scrum, Prosci, PPS etc
* Erfarenhet från våra fokusbranscher: bank/finans, energi, offentlig sektor, medlemsorganisationer eller försvar
* Erfarenhet av roller/uppdrag där generativ AI varit en del av den utvecklade produkten/tjänsten


 AI i din vardag
   

  

* Du gillar att hänga med i den snabba AI-utvecklingen och är hands on i användningen för att effektivisera ditt personliga arbete i rollen
* Du driver och stöttar teamet i att etablera arbetssätt där de använder AI-assistenter smart och säkert, samt med tydlig koppling till nytta och ansvar för etik och påverkan på människor
* Du kan även hjälpa kundens olika stakeholders att interagera effektivt med AI-accelererade utvecklingsteam


 Exempel på uppdrag
   

  

* Vara produktägare för en digital självservicetjänst hos ett finansbolag där uppdraget är både att vidareutveckla tjänsten och att öka kvalitet och effektivitet med AI-baserade verktyg och arbetssätt
* Driva ett förändringsinitiativ för en större myndighet som ska gå från pilot till att skala upp användningen av agenter i Microsoft/CoPilot-miljö


 Varför B3 Business Transformation?
   

  

* Ett prisbelönt konsultbolag: Ambitiöst och prestigelöst med en kultur av samarbete och frihet för seniora konsulter.
* Erfarna kollegor: Du blir del av ett team med seniora projektledare, produktägare och managementkonsulter som delar kunskap och uppdrag och utforskar framtidens teknik, arbetssätt och konsultaffär tillsammans.
* Effektiv och transparent säljprocess: En AI-driven säljprocess inklusive matchning mellan uppdrag och konsulterna, som har full insyn och inflytande.
* B3:s AI-ekosystem: Hos oss får du både uppdrag i framkant och kollegor som vill utforska vad AI betyder för framtidens projektledning, produktutveckling – och konsultrollen i stort.

title: Head of Marketing (70k-90k SEK/month + Equity) at well-funded healthtech startup
description:
**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Head of Marketing
   

  

**Salary**
 70k-90k SEK/month + Equity
   

  

**Company Description**
 Well-funded healthtech startup
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the first marketing hire at a high-growth healthtech startup, you will own the end-to-end strategy from brand and PR to performance and CRM. You'll move from a hands-on solo lead to building a global function, driving user acquisition and international expansion for a disruptive at-home diagnostic platform.
   

  

**Location**
 Stockholm, Sweden
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Shape the future of women's health with a category-defining diagnostic platform backed by top-tier VCs.
* Experience true ownership as the first marketing hire, building systems from scratch rather than inheriting legacy processes.
* Join a high-growth venture with over 30% month-on-month growth and a massive, underserved global market opportunity.


**What You Will Do**
* Lead global growth and go-to-market strategies across Europe and North America to drive user acquisition and retention.
* Own the brand, PR, and communications strategy to position the company as a leading authority in digital health.
* Execute data-driven performance marketing campaigns and build personalized CRM journeys to optimize customer lifetime value.


**The ideal candidate**
* Proven experience as the first marketing hire in a seed-stage startup, building from zero to one.
* Deep expertise in subscription-based marketing, including CAC/LTV optimization and lifecycle management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to manage budgets, negotiate partnerships, and connect marketing activities to business outcomes.


**Who are Jack & Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The role**
 We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to shape the core experience of the most intuitive legal platform in the world. You’ll work end-to-end—exploring ideas, crafting clear interfaces, and refining details in close collaboration with engineers. The role is execution-first: your strength lies in turning complex workflows into simple, powerful interfaces, especially as we design new patterns for working with AI.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Design user flows, interactions, and interfaces for AI-powered tools
* Turn ambiguous problems into concrete, high-quality product experiences
* Work hands-on with engineers to bring your designs to life
* Use Figma to design, document, and iterate with speed
* Contribute to—and help scale—our design system
* Push for clarity, consistency, and quality in every corner of the product


**Who You Are**
* Strong experience designing digital products end-to-end
* A portfolio that shows clear thinking, elegant UI, and shipped product work
* Sharp visual skills and attention to detail
* Curiosity about how AI changes user behavior and interfaces
* Pragmatism and a bias toward shipping over theorizing


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Shaping tomorrow's communication and the stuff we haven't named yet
description:
At Curious Mind, we are moving ideas and brands across borders. The communication landscape is shifting rapidly, driven by AI, evolving processes, and new platforms. We don’t just produce content; we solve complex challenges, build for the future, and help our clients scale. We are looking for those "outliers", the people who can help us move our business into the next era.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 You might be at the beginning of your career or have many years of experience. To us, your mindset and drive matter most. We seek colleagues who are fearless yet humble, and who possess a deep love for their craft while being eager to reinvent their own processes.Your path to us might look like one of these:
   

  

* **The communication artisan:** 
 You have a deep foundation in language, copywriting, or linguistics. You are a specialist who knows that even the smartest AI needs human precision to truly connect, but you are restless to see how technology can amplify your impact.
* **The technical architect** 
 : Your strengths lean toward systems, visual programming, or AI implementation. You aren’t necessarily a software developer, but you understand how tools and logic can transform a creative vision into a scalable reality.
* **The hybrid pioneer** 
 : You sit somewhere in between, thrive in constant change, and possess the self-confidence to challenge "how things have always been done", all while being humble enough to learn from the team.


 What we do together
   

  

 As part of our team, you will help our clients transform how they work. We look at AI as our primary enabler, a powerful partner that helps us streamline workflows, solve complex business challenges, and make content scalable. Together, we will:
   

  

* Streamline and scale: Help clients automate the mundane and design intelligent processes that work across global markets.
* Solve complex puzzles: Step into shifting environments, analyze current operations, and build smarter, more resilient ways forward.
* Pioneer the unknown: Actively test emerging technologies. We don't just follow the curve; we help define it.


 Why Curious Mind
   

  

 We are a Nordic content partner with global reach and part of the Eidra network. Here, you’ll find a community of experts who value depth of knowledge as much as the courage to question it and create change.
   

  

 Are you ready to join our journey?
   

  

 We review applications and interview continuously. If you are a specialist who loves change, we want to hear from you!
   

  

 Curious Mind is a Nordic content partner with a global reach, fueled by curiosity. Our team of around 50 content consultants helps brands across the Nordics grow through digital communication, with impact that travels far beyond our borders.
   

  

 We’re proud to be part of Eidra, a carefully selected group of specialist companies. While we each have our own craft, we’re united by a shared ambition: to help our clients become leaders in their fields.
   

  

 Our modern offices in the heart of Stockholm are home to a vibrant community, where we work side by side with our sister agencies.

title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
description:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
   

  

* Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
* Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
* Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
* Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.


 Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
   

  

**Vocal Synthesis** 
 — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
   

  

**Post-Training** 
 — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
   

  

**Editing** 
 — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
   

  

 You will also:
   

  

* Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
* Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
* Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
* Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
* Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
* You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
* You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
* You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
* You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
* You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
* You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
* You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location
* This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zone for collaboration.
* Core working hours are CET 3pm-6pm / EST 9am-12pm.

Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

title: Customer Success Manager

* Strong relationship-building skills to foster trust and collaboration with customers.
* Excellent communication skills in English; additional languages are a bonus.
* Ability to analyze and report on customer data to derive actionable insights.
* Proficiency in upselling and negotiating with customers.
* Initiative and adaptability to meet changing customer and business needs.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a customer-first approach.
* Commercial mindset and understanding of business principles to drive growth.
* A humble, grounded, and collaborative attitude.


 At Bannerflow, we live by our values of passion, collaboration, and challenge.  We believe that our employees are the key to our success and we are dedicated to building a positive and supportive work environment where our employees can thrive and grow. We are looking for a Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience as a developer or in a related field, including minimum 3 years of Data Engineering, who wants to grow within the data domain and work with modern technologies in a meaningful way. * Ensure high data quality, security, and maintainability across solutions
* Collaborate with clients to translate business needs into robust technical solutions
* Act as a bridge between modern technologies and sustainable system design

You work at assignments at our client's site.
  
* Develop and optimize data pipelines using tools such as Python, SQL, and modern data platforms
* Work with cloud and data processing technologies like Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Spark, or dbt
* Participate in client projects where you ensure long-term value and technical excellence
* Explore and apply AI tools to enhance development workflows while maintaining high standards


**Qualifications and Requirements:**  

* A university degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field
* 5+ years as a developer, with minimum 3 years in Data Engineering
* Strong skills in Python and SQL
* Experience with building data pipelines and working with modern data platforms
* Familiarity with tools such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark, or dbt is a plus
* Interest in AI and modern coding tools such as coding agents
* Fluent in Swedish, both spoken and written.


**Personal Attributes:**  

* Quality-oriented mindset with a strong understanding that data quality is the foundation of all analytics and AI
* Technically curious with a broad interest in data, systems, and new technologies
* Able to critically evaluate AI-generated code and ensure it is secure and scalable
* A collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge
* Driven by learning and continuous improvement
* Care by design in every solution


**Career Development Opportunities & Benefits:**  

* Opportunity to shape your role and influence how modern consulting evolves in an AI-driven world
* Work on cutting-edge projects while focusing on long-term, sustainable solutions
* A stable and secure environment backed by experienced founders
* Competitive salary, pension, and benefits
* A supportive and human-centric workplace culture
